blocks.content: In this example, we will create a program to check if a string is a palindrome or not.
A palindrome is a string that spells the same forward and backward. For example, "pullup" is a palindrome because:

items: The first and the last characters are the same.
The second and the second-last characters are the same.
The third and the third-last characters are the same.

blocks.alt: A Palindrome With Even Number of Characters

blocks.content: In the case of a string with an odd number of characters (such as "level"), we will have one remaining character.
The "level" string is a palindrome because:

items: The first and the last characters are the same.
The second and the second-last characters are the same.
There is a single character left, v.

blocks.alt: A Palindrome With Odd Number of Characters
